lastCompletedStory.title: Require ci-container in branch protection and update the runbook oracle

openQuestions: Pre-existing (not introduced by US-002): `bun run check:all`'s check:file-size gate fails on test/ci-workflow.test.ts:104 exceeding its 75-line budget ceiling; this was already failing on the US-001 commit before this story started (confirmed via `git stash` + `bun scripts/check-file-sizes.ts` on the pre-US-002 tree). Out of scope for US-002 (surgical-changes discipline: US-002 never touches test/ci-workflow.test.ts). typecheck and bun test (the story's actual gate oracles) are both green. A follow-up should raise the ceiling in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a tracker ref, or split the describe block.
nextStoryContext: configureBranchProtection (src/release/branch-protection.ts) now requires BOTH 'ci' and 'ci-container' as required status checks: REQUIRED_CHECK_NAMES = ['ci', 'ci-container'] const, buildProtectionBody() maps it to checks:[{context}...], and hasAllRequiredChecks() (renamed from hasCiCheck, now takes the parsed GET response and does an .every() over REQUIRED_CHECK_NAMES against hasCheck() which itself checks either the checks[] or deprecated contexts[] shape per-name) gates the configured-and-verified vs fallback-warned outcome. BRANCH_PROTECTION_FALLBACK_HINT text now names both checks. docs/recovery-runbook.md's manual-setup steps and --jq verification query both now document 'ci' and 'ci-container'. renovate.json was NOT touched (verified via git diff --exit-code renovate.json): the container-scoped automerge rules (asdf, dockerfile) are now correctly gated because ci-container is a required branch-protection check. GOTCHA for any future required-check-set change: grep every test file for hand-rolled protectionResponseChecks()-style fixtures (test/commands/setup-merge-mode.test.ts and test/commands/config-merge-mode.test.ts each keep their own local copy, not imported from branch-protection.test.ts) -- widening the check-name set silently flips their fixtures' outcome from configured-and-verified to fallback-warned if not updated in lockstep; bun test test/release/branch-protection.test.ts alone will NOT catch this, only the full bun test run does.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed PUT required_status_checks accepts both 'checks' (current, {context, app_id?}) and deprecated 'contexts' (string array); GET response returns both fields simultaneously. Implementation's per-check-name dual-shape acceptance (hasCheck checking checks[] OR contexts[] per required name) matches this documented dual-field behavior.
